request: Use the tweak-my-term plugin. I want a whole new terminal, something really different from what I have now: vaporwave, aesthetically pleasing, optical looking.

persona.who: A developer on Windows who uses Windows Terminal with Git Bash every day, sometimes PowerShell. Not a theming expert.
persona.wants: Dark vaporwave: pink, purple and cyan, a retro sunset with a grid as the background but text must stay readable. Likes a two-line prompt with git info. Would like a side pane with a system fetch and a clock next to the main shell. Fine with installing free tools and a Nerd Font. Keep the existing aliases.
